# Solcast

Solar resource assessment and forecasting data for irradiance and PV power, globally.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/solcast/.

## Actions

- **Create PV Power Resource**: Create a new PV power resource for Advanced PV Power forecasting.
- **Get Historic Radiation And Weather** (read-only): Get historical irradiance and weather estimated actuals for a requested location.
- **Get PV Power Resource** (read-only): Retrieve a specific PV power resource by its unique identifier.
- **Get Resources PV Power Sites** (read-only): List PV power resources available to authenticated user.
- **Patch PV Power Resource**: Partially update an existing PV power resource's technical specifications.
- **Update PV Power Resource**: Update an existing PV power resource with comprehensive technical specifications for solar installation site modeling.
